observations: 120 closed H4 bars: window opens 2504.38 (bar 1) and closes 2675.48 (bar 120); traded extremes are 2358.62 (bar 70 low) and 2850.00 (bar 104 high).
Bars 3-44 are a two-sided range between 2411.04 (bar 39 low) and 2528.80 (bar 18 high); closes stayed inside 2436.83-2513.46 with heavy bar overlap and mid-range closes.

Bar 45 (open 2457.12) spiked to 2680.00 and closed 2555.52, i.e. 124.48 (53%) below its 235.81-range high; bar 46 (high 2607.62, close 2538.73) did not extend, so that upside breakout produced no follow-through.
Bars 45-70 sold off from 2680.00 to the window low 2358.62, with bars 69 (close 2423.29) and 70 (close 2412.95) closing near their lows, followed by an up reversal.

Bars 70-104 advanced 2358.62 to 2850.00 in two pushes: to 2643.52 (bar 88 high), pullback to 2568.16 (bar 98 low), then to 2850.00 (bar 104); bull spike bars 87-88 (closes 2578.60 and 2636.28) and bar 104 carry most of the range expansion.
Bar 104 (open 2658.81, close 2723.15) left a 126.85 upper tail at 2850.00; the 16 bars since (105-120) have not exceeded 2804.59 (bar 107), with highs 2795.00 (bar 105) and 2786.81 (bar 115).

The pullback from 2850.00 to 2641.37 (bar 118) retraces about 74% of the 2568.16-2850.00 push and has traded back through the 2658.06 origin low of bar 104 and below the 2700.00 highs of bars 92 and 102.

Bar 117 (open 2726.71, low 2648.49, close 2659.00) closed below the 2716.01 (bar 109) and 2717.02 (bar 116) lows; bars 118-120 then held a 2641.37-2695.84 pause, and the last bar closed 2675.48, below bar 119's 2684.16 and below its own 2678.47 midpoint.

No compression tighter than the four-bar 2641.37-2727.77 pause sits at the decision bar, so the window is read as a deep pullback/range inside the bull structure rather than a discrete pre-breakout setup.

structures.description: Early two-sided range (bars 3-44) between 2411.04 and 2528.80; both edges were tested repeatedly without acceptance, with overlapping bars and closes held inside 2436.83-2513.46.
Bear leg (bars 45-70) from the failed 2680.00 spike high to the window low 2358.62; overlapping bars with bars 69-70 closing near their lows, then a reversal up that made no lower low.

Bull advance (bars 70-104) from 2358.62 to 2850.00 in two pushes separated by a pullback to 2568.16; higher highs 2680.00, 2700.00 (bars 92 and 102) and 2850.00, with spike bars 87-88 and 104 doing most of the work.

Pullback/range after the 2850.00 spike (bars 105-120): 2641.37-2804.59 with lower highs 2850.00 to 2804.59 to 2786.81, a break below the 2716.01-2717.02 lows on bar 117, then a three-bar 2641.37-2695.84 pause.

Unconfirmed major-trend-reversal shape from bar 104 on: 2850.00 spike high with a 126.85 upper tail, lower highs 2804.59/2786.81, a bear bar at 117 closing near its low, and a lower low 2641.37 below 2716.01; not confirmed because bars 118-119 recovered and the 2568.16 higher low still holds.

evidence_for: Swing structure since bar 70 is bullish: higher highs 2680.00 to 2700.00 (bars 92, 102) to 2850.00, and higher lows 2358.62 to 2568.16, with the current pullback low 2641.37 still above 2568.16.
Trend bars dominate the advance: bar 87 closed 2578.60 (7.10 under its 2585.50 high), bar 88 closed 2636.28 above bar 87's high, and bar 104 ran 2658.81 to 2850.00 and closed 2723.15.
The pullback is testing the 2658.06 origin low of the bar-104 spike and the 2700.00 double top (bars 92 and 102), i.e. the usual pullback-to-breakout-point location in a bull trend.
Buyers appeared at that zone: bars 118-119 recovered 2641.37 to 2684.16, and bars 118-120 overlap rather than trending down.
The prior deep pullback (bars 89-98 to 2568.16) was bought, so two-sided pullbacks have so far been part of this advance rather than a change of trend.
evidence_against: The bull-trend label covers only the last 51 of 120 bars: the first 44 bars are a 2411.04-2528.80 range, the bar-45 spike to 2680.00 failed, and price later made a lower low at 2358.62, so a whole-window trading-range read (2358.62-2850.00) is equally available.

Strongest counterargument: bar 104's 126.85 upper tail after a fast run to 2850.00 resembles a buy climax, and the sequence since (lower highs 2804.59 and 2786.81, a lower low 2641.37 under 2716.01, and bar 117 closing 2659.00 near its low) is an mtr-like shape that would be confirmed by a close below 2568.16.
The pullback gives back about 74% of the final push and the last close 2675.48 is only 10.75 above bar 102's close 2664.73, 18 bars earlier, so the 2850.00 breakout has produced no net progress.
No close above 2804.59 in 16 bars, and the close sits below the 2722.98 midpoint of the 2641.37-2804.59 pullback range, so near-term control is not clearly with the bulls.
Bar 104's spike origin at 2658.06 was already slightly undercut (2641.37 on bar 118), which weakens the bull-flag reading of the current congestion.
transition_conditions: A close above 2695.84 and then above 2804.59 would restore the bull-continuation read and mark the 16-bar pause as a completed bull flag.
A close above 2850.00 with follow-through would resolve the climax question bullishly and confirm trend continuation.
A close back above 2727.77 (bar 117 high) would negate the bear break of the 2716.01 support.
A close below 2641.37 followed by a close below 2568.16 would confirm a lower high/lower low reversal on this H4 chart and put the bull structure in doubt.

Two strong bear bars closing near their lows below 2641.37 would shift the read from deep pullback to bear leg or trading range; continued overlap between 2641.37 and 2804.59 without a close beyond either edge keeps the current pullback/range read.
